what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted only to approve prior minutes and to adjourn; it took no vote on any budget item.
The committee reviewed the Capital Planning Committee's ranked list; many project costs are rough estimates without bids, and it questioned whether the list can be pared given free cash.
The Chair said the committee will ask department heads for budget numbers a week ahead and for presentations at least 72 hours ahead.
The Chair will ask the school department and town manager for current health insurance numbers; the town manager said a small balance remains in the health insurance stabilization fund.
The town manager's email said the governor's 9C cuts do not hit local aid and no impact to Lunenburg is expected; reorganization was deferred until all seven members attend.

why_it_matters: The capital list sets how much the town will ask for beyond the operating budget, and its costs are still estimates without bids, so the figures residents later vote on may move.
Health insurance and expiring grants can raise the town's share of the school and town budgets without any service changing, and the committee has not yet seen current numbers.
watch_next: The town manager's presentation of the capital plan to the committee, which this review was preparing for.
The current health insurance numbers the Chair will request from the school department and town manager.
